changes: Replace blanket rejection of powered NVDEC with explicit B01 inherited-idle checks; require NVJPG dependency already powered, both partitions unclamped, clocks gated and resets asserted. Reject cold/busy/unknown states without PMC writes.
Retain inherited partition power and NVJPG reset/clock/source. Do not execute the T210-only SLCG/MBIST workaround on B01.
Require parent-supplied Host1x/PLLP clock ownership callbacks. Never write CAR L or reset shared Host1x globally. Failed acquire/release retains the owner record for cleanup.
Do not zero live ownership on reinitialization. Stop only the reserved channel; require reset acknowledgement, stable MC drain and empty Host1x FIFO before retirement. Preserve other clients bits.

With the owned channel stopped and quiesced, clear DMA backing pointers and initialize empty GET/PUT; verify readback before releasing the clock. This enables retry after timeout and never writes a syncpoint.
Kernel backend accepts parent-owned register callbacks and explicit reserved channel/syncpoint instead of full raw apertures and hardcoded11/31; reject a mismatched submit syncpoint.
The retired replacement probe explicitly returns not-supported; it cannot manufacture a clock/resource owner.
